collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: An elder who never climbed the highest hill decides to try, slowly, with a friend: go all the way, or go as far as feels right.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has lived on Isola (subject.his/her) whole life and has never once climbed to the very top of the highest hill. There was always something else to do. Now (subject.his/her) knees are stiff and (subject.his/her) breath is short on steep paths, and (subject.he/she) has decided that this is the season (subject.he/she) is going to do it, slowly. (subject.He/she) asks (friend) to come along.

choices.label: Go as Far as Feels Right

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They set off at first light and stop whenever (subject) wants to, which is often. It takes all day. Near the top (subject) has to sit for a long while. But (subject.he/she) gets there, and stands at the very top with the whole island spread out below, and says nothing at all for a long time.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: They climb until (subject) says, "This will do." It's a little below the top, on a rock with a wonderful view of the sea. They eat lunch there. "We could go on," says (friend). "We could," says (subject). "I'd rather sit here." (subject.He/she) is perfectly happy with that. The top of the hill will still be there.
